subject: Delivery of failed emails re. PIPEDA & ISO27001
body:
Hi Sam and Magda,
 
Hope you are doing well.
 
I was just told that some of the emails we have sent to you or your colleagues are not delivered due to the following reason:
 
Service unavailable; Client host [a1.mail.mailgun.net] blocked using Barracuda Reputation; http://www.barracudanetworks.com/reputation/?r=1&ip=198.61.254.60 (sam.wright@essex.ac.uk:blocked)
 
This happened once again a couple of months ago. We submitted a request to Barracuda asking them to correct this, but did not hear back.
 
I'm also not sure why this is happening. We manage our in-house email solution, powered by Mailgun, and never had an issue. We will find an alternative on our end, but also you may want to check with Barracuda. There might be more false positives!
 
Email 1 - Re. ISO 27001 - Sent on 2024-10-07 10:57 UTC
Hi Sam and Magda,

Hope you are doing well and had a nice weekend.

I wanted to give you a quick update on the ISO27001 progress. We had our Stage 1 audit last Wednesday and it went fairly smoothly. There was 2 Potential for Improvements and 1 minor non-conformity (our Statement of Applicability did not have required Information Security Attributes).

The auditor's informal assessment was that our work was one of the high-quality ones he had seen and was very satisfied with the result. We expect to get the formal assessment sometime this week and then book for Stage 2 audit within the next month, depending on their availability.

So we should be well on track to have the certification before end of the year.

Best,
Mohammad
 
Email 2 - Re. PIPEDA - Sent on 2024-10-10 15:52 UTC

Good afternoon Sam,

Hope all is well on your end.

Yes, our servers are located in Canada, and our company is subject to and complies with PIPEDA Act.

Best,
Mohammad
 
--
Mohammad Hashemian
Founder, Chief Executive Officer,
Avicenna Research Inc. (formerly Ethica Data)

Best wishes,

body:

I am optimistic we can have it by the end of Nov. or possibly sooner. That's why I think it's best not to focus on this as a risk. I will circle back if the situation changes.
 
Best,
Mohammad

subject: RE: Delivery of failed emails re. PIPEDA & ISO27001
body:
Hi Mohammad.

 

Sorry for the delayed response… It’s been a busy week!

 

Firstly, I’m pleased to hear the certification process is progressing positively. Please do keep us posted. Secondly, I’m also pleased to hear Avicenna is within scope of the PIPDEA and therefore meets the adequacy requirements from an ICO Data Protection perspective. This allows us to consider the option of Avicenna fully hosting the solution for ourselves, which makes things easier on both sides I imagine. And thirdly, I have reached out to those who manage our Barracuda mail protection service to see if any overrides can be performed locally, and/or whether they are able to also log this with Barracuda to help resolve the non-delivery issue. I’ll let you know of any developments in this regard.

 

Many thanks,

 

Sam Wright

Sam Wright CISM, MBCS

Information Technology and Security Manager (ITSM)

Institute for Social and Economic Research (ISER)

University of Essex, Colchester, CO4 3SQ

www.iser.essex.ac.uk
